svg.title: Databricks on AWS — structural architecture
svg.desc: Three-plane diagram showing Control Plane, Compute Plane, and Storage/Governance layers of a Databricks workspace on AWS

g.text: Managed by Databricks — runs in Databricks' own AWS account
Runs inside your AWS account — your VPC, your EC2
Your S3 buckets — data never leaves your AWS account
Unity Catalog — single control point for access, lineage, audit
How data is stored and queried on top of S3
